standard: IEEE 1800-2023 10.4.2 (Syntax 10-3): the target of a nonblocking assignment is a variable_lvalue, which includes a streaming_concatenation; 11.4.14.3: a streaming concatenation target unpacks the value, so {<< 4 {hi, lo}} <= 8'h01 updates hi to 4'h1 and lo to 4'h0 in the NBA region.
method: The shared case runs unchanged in verify-sv-verilator, verify-sv-icarus and verify-sv-xezim; the reduced source below runs without the adapters (verilator --binary, iverilog -g2012 -s Top, xezim). The blocking assignment to the same kind of target is the control.
